hypotheses.B1_layer17_joint_rank_advantage: Layer-17 joint axes reduce median rank90 by at least 20% relative to the mean random rotation of the same 32D subspace.
hypotheses.B2_layer0_joint_rank_advantage: Layer-0 joint axes reduce median rank90 by at least 20% relative to the mean random rotation of the same 32D subspace.
hypotheses.B3_layer17_joint_concentration: Layer-17 joint axes increase median first-role energy by at least 0.10 relative to the mean same-subspace random rotation.
hypotheses.B4_architectural_depth_gap: Layer 17 exceeds layer 0 in median first-role energy by at least 0.20 even for random ambient bases.
hypotheses.B5_control_stability: The coefficient of variation of median first-role energy across the three controls is below 0.10 for every layer and control family.
